patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than Cognism's shape. Workflow advantage: Cognism leans contact-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: Cognism (mid-market, enterprise) vs Snov.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Cognism-leaning contact-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing; Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid Cognism if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
